title: Finite rational compact-support target comparison with scalar compatibility
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, a finite-field datum D with l ≠ D.p, finite-type D.k-schemes X,Y,Z, separated finite-type maps f:X→Y and g:X→Z over D.k, and an isomorphism e:Y≅Z with f;e=g. Require l invertible in residue fields of Y and Z. For normalized ring systems R,R' and their field systems F,F' [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-adjunction-coefficients], and compactifications c of f and c' of g, there exist natural isomorphisms a_i from the rational left operation of R at the finite coefficient field i to the rational left operation of R' followed by rational inverse image under e. They satisfy the scalar square TY(a_i);βP;P_j(βR')=βR;a_j(TX(-)) for every inclusion i≤j. Here the transition functors are those of def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, βR and βR' are the field-system q maps conjugated by their specified transition identifications, and βP is the normalized rational pullback scalar comparison [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. The conclusion concerns only finite rational coefficient categories: it does not refer to the closed operations, stage inclusions, or a common-stage comparison.

theorem compact_support_target_rational_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{max u v}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Z.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Z ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X ⟶ Z) (e : Y ≅ Z) (h : f ≫ e.hom = g)
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (R : RingSystem.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f))
    (F : FieldSystem.{u, v} l Ω D hl R) (c : Compactification f)
    (R' : RingSystem.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := g))
    (F' : FieldSystem.{u, v} l Ω D hl R') (c' : Compactification g) :
    ∃ a : ∀ i : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω,
      (R.operation c (.rational (commonField.{u, v} l Ω i))).F ≅
        (R'.operation c' (.rational (commonField.{u, v} l Ω i))).F ⋙
          rationalDerivedPullback l (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{max u v}
            l Ω i) e.hom,
      ∀ {i j : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω} (hij : i ≤ j)
        (K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (.rational (commonField.{u, v} l Ω i))),
        ((stageSystem l Ω Y).T hij).map ((a i).hom.app K) ≫
            (commonStagePullbackTransition l Ω e.hom hij).hom.app
              ((R'.operation c' (.rational (commonField.{u, v} l Ω i))).F.obj K) ≫
            (rationalDerivedPullback l
              (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{max u v} l Ω j) e.hom).map
                ((rationalOperationTransition l Ω D hl R' F' c' hij).hom.app K) =
          (rationalOperationTransition l Ω D hl R F c hij).hom.app K ≫
            (a j).hom.app (((stageSystem l Ω X).T hij).obj K)
